genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 议论文核心主体段
domain_context: 顶会口头汇报（Tech Talk）与图表引导
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 1】假设你正在撰写【CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 / TOEFL 议论文核心主体段】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。”。请严格按照 `BP34` 的逐句功能骨架（4 步法）与逻辑法则 `L004`（概念浓缩指代词（This/Such + Summary Noun）），写出一段 4–5 句、零 AI 痕迹、主语紧凑（≤6词）的自然英文段落。
source_material_or_draft: First, AI can improve working efficiency a lot. People have many boring tasks every day. If AI does these tasks, people can save time and do better things. For example, my friend uses AI to write emails and saves two hours every day. So AI is very helpful.
structural_constraints: S1 [分论点主题句 Topic Claim]：一句话清晰亮出本段唯一控制中心（[Policy/Factor X] strengthens [Outcome Y] by [Core Mechanism]）。
S2 [因果机制推演 Causal Elaboration]：Explain HOW and WHY：阐明如果没有这层干扰或有了这项机制，认知/经济/技术流程会发生什么具体改变。
S3 [具象微观案例 Concrete Micro-Case]：For instance, when [Specific Group/Industry] [Specific Action], [Measurable/Observable Consequence]（绝不编造假百分比，用具体场景细节说话）。
S4 [反事实对比或扣题升华 Warrant / Link Back]：Thus, [Summary Noun] shifts human effort from [Low-value Routine] toward [High-value Judgment].
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）
补全定量指标-基线-条件三元组或具象行业微案例

genre_target: 顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）
domain_context: 六级/雅思大作文：AI 自动化、教育与科研伦理
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。
prompt_zh: 【表达意图→段落构建 2】假设你正在撰写【顶会 Rebuttal 核心争议攻防段（Novelty Defense）】。你这一段的核心表达意图是：“我这一段想回复审稿人最致命的质疑：'The method seems like a simple combination of existing Module A and Module B (limited novelty).' 既不顶撞审稿人，又能用理论+消融数据证明“绝对不是简单拼凑”。”。请按 `BP46` 的句子角色分工，先列出每句的主语核心词与谓语强动词，再连缀成完整段落。
source_material_or_draft: We did comprehensive experiments on many datasets. The results show that our model beats all baselines by a large margin and is very fast.
structural_constraints: S1 [礼貌接招并定位误解核心 Courteous Reframing]：We appreciate Reviewer X's comment on architectural design and would like to clarify the fundamental distinction between our coupled formulation and a naive combination of [A] and [B].
S2 [点破简单拼接为何会失败 Why Naive Combination Fails]：Directly stacking standard [A] and [B] fails on [Problem] because [Theoretical Conflict / Gradient Interference].

S3 [阐明本文核心数学/机制桥梁 Our Core Coupling Innovation]：Our core contribution lies not in using [A] or [B] in isolation, but in deriving the [Specific Coupling Mechanism C], which resolves [Conflict] by [Mathematical Guarantee].

S4 [用直接对比实验一锤定音 Empirical Proof of Non-Triviality]：To verify this empirically, we implemented the exact naive concatenation baseline (`Naive A+B`) in Table R2: our coupled formulation outperforms `Naive A+B` by [14.6%] in MSE, confirming that the performance gain stems from our coupling mechanism rather than mere module stacking.
target_defects_to_fix: 过度名词化僵尸句 + 被动语态滥用（Over-Nominalization & Passive Abuse）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）
消除口语词与 AI 套话（delve into / pivotal role / testament to）

genre_target: CET-6 / IELTS Task 2 原因分析段，或学术评论文章
domain_context: 基于扩散/流匹配的缺失时序插补与生成
communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想在问题分析类作文（Why is this happening?）中，剖析某个社会/科研痛点背后的深层原因（既指出直接表层诱因，又挖出底层的考核激励或结构性根源）。
prompt_zh: 【深度病段修改诊所 3：专治重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）】下方议论/分析段落使用了烂大街的万能模板句且缺乏具象实例支撑。请砍掉全部套话外壳，并运用 `L021`（一句话具象行业微观案例法）重写该段。
source_material_or_draft: Figure 2 shows our model. There is a Patch Encoder on the left. In the middle, there is a Spectral Block and a Graph Block. On the right, a Linear Decoder outputs the result.
structural_constraints: S1 [原因总起句 Dual-Cause Thesis]：The widespread emergence of [Problem X] stems from both immediate technological pressures and deeper institutional incentives.
S2 [第一层：直接操作/技术诱因 Immediate Driver]：At the operational level, [Factor A] lowers the cost of [Behavior], tempting individuals/organizations to [Short-term Action].

S3 [第二层：深层制度/激励根源 Structural Root Cause]：More fundamentally, existing evaluation systems reward [Superficial Metric] rather than [Long-term Quality], creating powerful pressure to prioritize speed over rigor.
S4 [双因叠加后果 Compounding Effect]：When effortless generation meets quantity-driven evaluation, [Problem X] becomes systemic rather than isolated.
target_defects_to_fix: 重度 AI 套话 + 空洞夸张无具体指标（Heavy AI-ese & Hollow Hyperbole）
消除头重脚轻（主语 ≤ 6-8 词，遵循尾重原则 L011）

communicative_intent_zh: 我这一段想写大作文的第一个主体段（Body Paragraph 1）：论证某个核心优势或必要性，做到有理有据、有具象场景支撑，绝不车轱辘话来回说。
prompt_zh: 【多段贯通写作实战 1：Academic_QA_Defense 核心章节连写】参照全文样板 `FT10 (学术答辩与组会 6 大高频刁钻提问应答全案（Novelty、超参敏感性、极端噪声、计算复杂度、失败案例与未来扩展）)` 的段落蓝图链 `BP44 -> BP46 -> BP20`，围绕你自己的研究方向（深度学习 / 时间序列 / 生成模型 / 具身智能）写出连续 3 个逻辑咬合的自然段，并标注段间过渡钩子（`L027`）。
source_material_or_draft: First, AI can improve working efficiency a lot. People have many boring tasks every day. If AI does these tasks, people can save time and do better things. For example, my friend uses AI to write emails and saves two hours every day. So AI is very helpful.
structural_constraints: S1 [分论点主题句 Topic Claim]：一句话清晰亮出本段唯一控制中心（[Policy/Factor X] strengthens [Outcome Y] by [Core Mechanism]）。
S2 [因果机制推演 Causal Elaboration]：Explain HOW and WHY：阐明如果没有这层干扰或有了这项机制，认知/经济/技术流程会发生什么具体改变。
S3 [具象微观案例 Concrete Micro-Case]：For instance, when [Specific Group/Industry] [Specific Action], [Measurable/Observable Consequence]（绝不编造假百分比，用具体场景细节说话）。
S4 [反事实对比或扣题升华 Warrant / Link Back]：Thus, [Summary Noun] shifts human effort from [Low-value Routine] toward [High-value Judgment].
